title: Derived sections and total limit with specified projections
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a small site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] and $B_1\leftarrow B_2\leftarrow\cdots$ an inverse sequence of sheaves of commutative rings. Write $\mathscr S(B)$ for strict semilinear systems of module sheaves, with componentwise exactness, identified with modules over $B$ on the sequence site $\mathcal T=\mathcal C\times\mathbf N_{\ge1}$ [lem-pur-system-ringed-sequence-site]. Use unbounded derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let $A$ be a sheaf of commutative rings with compatible maps $A\to B_n$. Let $p:(\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal T),B)\to(\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C),A)$ have inverse image on underlying sheaves the constant sequence, with ring map given by $A\to B_n$. Let $U$ be exact termwise scalar restriction and $G=R\Gamma^{\operatorname{Tow}}_{\mathcal C}\circ U$ be the strict-system derived sections functor with its finite comparison of [lem-coef-sequence-global-sections-evaluation]. There is a specified natural isomorphism $$R\Gamma(\mathcal C,Rp_*J)\xrightarrow{\sim}R\lim\,G(J).$$ The comparison retains the actual finite projections: its nth projection is global sections of the total-limit projection followed by the scalar-restriction comparison at level $n$. All resolutions and comparisons are in the strict derived system categories, rather than unrelated choices at the fibers.
